title: system_word's proof and probe reach devices only as the commands he types
intention: system_word's proof and its probe his_case_never_bites import five devices' code to drive their folds: the ground loop's cli (proof :256, probe :106), the librarian's live (:329), sudo_relay's daemon (:341), the harbor master's _filter_fleet (proof :425, probe :141) and codemother's clearance (:463). A tool's proofs measure the tool (RULE 1). What a device exposes is its command and its bus.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: encapsulation_holds names cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_word.py:256,329,341,425,463 and cairn/tools/system_word/probes/his_case_never_bites.py:106,141. RULE 1: a component talks to another only through its public interface.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1 (a device's public interface is the bus plus any tool it publishes); outline 17.13.1.
how: test_system_word.py: the ground loop tooth drives `cairn groundloop --help/--HELP` and `status/STATUS` by subprocess; the sudo_relay tooth drives `cairn sudorelay --status/--STATUS` by subprocess (an unknown argument refuses with exit 2 and acquires nothing); the librarian part of the orient/chart/librarian tooth leaves (it berths with the librarian, c29a2d0dcebb PROVED); the harbor-master filter tooth leaves, its PROVES key harbor_master_filter re-pointed onto test_the_real_harbor_master_takes_uppercase_show_map_open, which already drives `cairn harbor_master show map OPEN`; the clearance tooth leaves with its key, since test_clearance.py:1882 already holds the Concept-Piece fold at its owner. his_case_never_bites.py drives `cairn groundloop --HELP` and compares `cairn harbor_master show map open/OPEN` by subprocess. New proof cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_word_proofs_measure_only_system_word.py carries the sieve and forbidden-module teeth.
